sources.researchNote: The VIAF cluster 221170232 also carries the Bibliothèque nationale de France heading “Bonnal, Ermend, 1880–1944, compositeur” (ark:/12148/cb16557102j), with a see-also reference between the two names. This supports identifying Guy Marylis as a name used by Joseph-Ermend Bonnal.

personNameVariants.publicNote: Pseudonym of Joseph-Ermend Bonnal, printed as Marylis on the French lyric recorded here. The Library of Congress holds a separate authority record for the pseudonymous identity, Marylis, Guy, 1880-1944, and the VIAF cluster that carries it also carries the Bibliothèque nationale heading Bonnal, Ermend, 1880-1944, compositeur, with a cross-reference between them.
